HOME SCIENCE MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
